Teekhi buddhi ek khamosh hatyara hai.
Man vichaaron se rangaa hai.
Dimaag ek aisi riyasat hai jahan parchhaiyon ka raaj hai.
Apani jeebh ko apani buddhi se aage mat jaane do.
Teekhi jubaan apne hi malik ko kaat ti hai.
Buddhi ek shandar dimaag ki parchhayi hai.
Ek khushnuma mazak dukh ki sabse acchi dawa hai.
Gyaani doosron ki galtiyon se seekhe.
Daya faulad se adhik majboot hai.
Ek chatur baat vyang ka gola hai.
Gyaani sthitiyon ke anusaar khud ko dhal leta hai.
Dil ek purane taal par dhadakta hai.
Buddhi dar se zang laga hua disha suchak hai.
Hum apni khamiyon se bachne ke liye videshi taton par jaate hain.
Teekhi buddhi gusse ke pahaad ko pighla deti hai.
Prasann hriday mehnat ko naach me badal deta hai.
Buddhi kadve imtihaanon ka meetha phal hai.
Manav aatma ek abodh jangli kshetra hai.
Ek chalak vyangy kadvi dushmani jeet leta hai.
Madhu ki ek boond sirke se jyada makkhiyaan pakde.
Ek chatur chaal gardan ko rassi se bachati hai.
Gyan apni agyanta ki gehrai ko janana hai.
Shaanti se khaya gaya sadhan bhojan bhi tyohaar hai.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Jo bahut soche, vah kuch nahi karta.
Sach hazaron chalak mukhauton ke peeche chhipa hai.
Agyan sabse tez bole.
Lalach rajaon ko dimaag ka bhikari bana deta hai.
Gyaan andhe ki aankh hai.
Khwahish insaan ko anjaane samandar paar karwa deti hai.
Dar kaagaj ke bagh hain.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Gyaani apane vichaaron mein khush rehta hai.
Ek chalak mazak zakhi rooh ko theek karta hai.
Chalak dimaag registan me bhi paani dhoond leta hai.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Ek khushnuma geet adharat toofaan ko chunauti deta hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
Gyaani apani chup se pahchane jaaye.
Buddhi ek aisa shisha hai jo moorkhata ko bada karta hai.
Sabse chalak jaal banane wale ko hi pakad leta hai.
Jo prashansa bachaaye, vah apana gun bhookha rakhe.
Moorh shor khoje; gyaani gahrai khoje.
Buddhi andar ki divya aag ki chingari hai.
Teekha jawab chatur ka kavach hota hai.
Ek chatur jeebh talwar ki dhaar par naachti hai.
Chalak dimaag apne hi daron ko maat de deta hai.
Tez buddhi anjaane khatron par jeet paati hai.
